Marissa — I pulled the nightly grant job run for 2027-11-09 (batch id: grant-20271109-02). Summary: batch started correctly but the wallet-sync step experienced timeouts against the WALLET service for a subset of accounts. Those accounts have entitlement records but no successful wallet-sync acknowledgement, which means the UI shows 0.

Key log excerpt (sanitized):

[2027-11-09 02:07:42 UTC] grant-20271109-02 INFO: applied entitlement user_id=usr_6219 grant_id=g-9f7c
[2027-11-09 02:07:43 UTC] wallet-sync WARN: user_id=usr_6219 sync_status=timeout duration=30000ms
[2027-11-09 02:07:43 UTC] retry 1 -> wallet-sync WARN: user_id=usr_6219 sync_status=timeout
[2027-11-09 02:07:44 UTC] grant-20271109-02 ERROR: batch partial-failure count=7 failing_step=wallet-sync

Initial hypothesis: an intermittent networking blip to the WALLET cluster caused the HTTP client to exhaust retries and return failures for ~7 accounts. The grant itself is idempotent, so rerunning the wallet-sync should reconcile balances. I will: (1) run a targeted wallet-sync for the affected user_ids, (2) surface metrics around retry/backoff, (3) create a short runbook for manual ops when this happens.

I attached the sanitized batch log. Will post back when manual sync is complete.
